name: Hachinohe Kozue
source:
A sophomore who is the ace of the women's basketball team. She is an energetic girl with a strong personality, and has a tough will that isn't afraid of anything.
She athletic with strong leadership skill, and has achieve good results is basketballs and all forms of athletics.
Because of this, she is highly demanded from various sports clubs, and because she wants to live up to other's expectations of her, she is always relied upon by them. 
Since she was so devoted to sports, she has not been involved in romantic relationships, and she believes she has not time for it, but she is still interested.
